CA.rationale: No explicit attention/allocation relation to the identified contents was present.

COD.rationale: Content (red positions), its organization/presentation (explicit position set) and a separate status/origin field are all explicitly present and bound to the same referent/time.

A.rationale: No explicit attention/allocation linkage to the identified content's organization/access was stated.

C.rationale: The report explicitly identifies contents (red, blue) with position attributes for a named referent/time.

D.rationale: An explicit origin/status field is attached to the identified content, distinguishing content identity from its provenance/status.

O.rationale: The report states how the content is presented as an explicit spatial pattern (explicit coordinate set) for the named referent/time.
